entries.title: Psalms 33:1
segments: Rejoice in the LORD, O righteous [ones;] praise is becoming for the upright.

entries.title: Psalms 33:2
segments: Praise the LORD with lyre; sing to Him with a harp of ten strings.

entries.title: Psalms 33:3
segments: Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with shouts of joy.

entries.title: Psalms 33:4
segments: For the word of the LORD [is] right; and all His works [are] in truth.

entries.title: Psalms 33:5
segments: [He] loves righteousness and judgment; the earth is full of the mercy of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 33:6
segments: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of His mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 33:7
segments: He gathered the waters of the sea like a heap, setting the depths in storehouses.

entries.title: Psalms 33:8
segments: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the people of the world stand in awe of Him.

entries.title: Psalms 33:9
segments: For He spoke, and it was [done]; He commanded, and it stood.

entries.title: Psalms 33:10
segments: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing; He breaks the plots of the people.

entries.title: Psalms 33:11
segments: The counsel of the LORD stands forever, the thoughts of His heart to all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 33:12
segments: Blessed [is] the nation whose God [is] the LORD; the people He has chosen for His inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 33:13
segments: The LORD looks down from Heaven; He beholds all the sons of mankind.

entries.title: Psalms 33:14
segments: From His dwelling place He looks on all the people of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 33:15
segments: Together He forms their hearts; His understanding [is] to all their works.

entries.title: Psalms 33:16
segments: The king is not saved by a great army; a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

entries.title: Psalms 33:17
segments: A horse [is] a vain thing for safety; neither shall he deliver by his great strength.

entries.title: Psalms 33:18
segments: Behold, the eye of the LORD [is] to those who fear Him, on those who hope in His mercy;

entries.title: Psalms 33:19
segments: to deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

entries.title: Psalms 33:20
segments: Our soul waits for the LORD; He [is] our help and our shield.

entries.title: Psalms 33:21
segments: For our heart shall rejoice in Him, because we trust in His holy name.

entries.title: Psalms 33:22
segments: Let Your mercy, O LORD, be on us, according as we hope in You.
